title: corydalis diphylla subsp. murreeana
intro: Corydalis diphylla subsp. murreeana, commonly known as Himalayan corydalis, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family, Papaveraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including pain relief, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan corydalis include analgesia, sedation, and muscle relaxation, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as insomnia, anxiety, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as protopine, corydaline, and berberine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
